create_dataset_instance: create a Flickr30kCaption dataset instance with data_root, data_prefix, ann_file, and split arguments
load_data_list: call load_data_list to load image-caption pairs filtered by the specified train val or test split
register_dataset_module: register the Flickr30kCaption class in the mmpretrain DATASETS registry for use in training pipelines
load_annotations: use mmengine to load the annotation file containing images with associated sentence captions
filter_by_split: filter dataset entries by split field to return only train val or test data from annotations
